title: A payer letter that writes a Social Security or phone number glued to another number (a currency amount's digits, an amount's cents or a date's end before its own shape; cents, a range after them, a second number or a date after it, after a phone with its area code in parentheses too; an amount's cents before a bare nine or ten), behind its label with the call's own identifier or the label's list number between them (in parentheses, or before a colon or a closing parenthesis; on the next line too), masked and glued to a word, a year, a date or an amount's cents, after a Social Security label glued to a word, or, in a letter whose digit chain only a range of two kinds holds, in a shape no pattern reads (amount-shaped, a five and four, a local number, beside the range)
assertion: No digit of it is sent: it is `[SSN]` or `[PHONE]`, or the letter is refused with `identifier_left`. A match ef3e8d20 did not make is applied only where the letter is not refused without it, and whatever is left as written is refused by the check (a property over labels, identifiers, list numbers and joined numbers, an invisible character among the joiners); a twin in its own shape with an amount, a range of amounts, a date or a second number glued to it is never sent with four of its digits in a row (a property). References a noun names, under a phone word or Medicare too where the noun stands nearer the number, or that no structure marks (`Case No. 123-45-678901`, `Medicare Summary Notice 802-45-678901`, `Referral # 123-45-67890-01`, `2026-0115-123-4567`, `20260115-12-3456`), a row of long numbers and dates, the cells of a row joined by a bar, a masked account number with its own first digits, a form's blank of underscores, a number in parentheses that follows no label and what a held letter places by its structure (ZIP+4 after a state, a TIN, a code list, a service-line row) are sent unchanged. Every row of ruling A in `redact.residuals.json` (697) is refused or redacted, row by row
